name: zeekr-shortcut-sentrymode-on
description: Turns on Zeekr sentry mode when the car is parked outside your geofences (Cloudflare Workers)
author: dts88

ZEEKR_EMAIL.description: 极氪副账号的邮箱：先在极氪 App 里把车分享给这个账号。不要用手机上正在登录的主账号，否则手机会被登出。 / Email of a second Zeekr account the car is shared with — not the one on your phone, or the phone gets signed out.

ZEEKR_PASSWORD.description: 上面这个副账号的密码。 / Password of that account.

GEOFENCES.description: 不自动开哨兵的地点，最多 10 个，用分号 ; 隔开。每个地点写：名称, 纬度, 经度, 半径米（半径可省略，默认 600）。例：`Home, 1.3521, 103.8198, 600; Office, 1.2840, 103.8510, 600`。经纬度：在 Google 地图上右键该地点，点一下弹出的数字即可复制。一个地点都不要就填 none。 / Up to 10 places where sentry mode is never turned on, separated by `;`. Each: name, latitude, longitude, radius in metres (default 600). Write none for no places.

STATE.description: 程序自动创建的存储，保持默认即可。 / Storage the program creates for itself; keep the default.
